title: Is Drinking Warm Lemon Water in the Morning a Metabolism Booster?

scenes.query: person squeezing lemon into warm water
scenes.text: Does a warm lemon drink jump‑start your metabolism each sunrise?

scenes.label: Lemon water = metabolism hac
scenes.text: Many think the acidity of lemon water revs up metabolism and burns extra calories.

scenes.label: No extra calorie burn
scenes.text: Studies show no measurable increase in resting metabolic rate from lemon water alone; hydration supports normal metabolism but doesn't act as a calorie‑burning catalyst.

scenes.label: Hydration, not magic
scenes.sub: Warm water with lemon can aid digestion, but don't expect weight loss spikes.
scenes.query: close-up of lemon slices in water
scenes.text: Enjoy it for taste and hydration, not calorie loss.
